items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Benny used to accompany Mattie Hite, who was one of the greatest entertainers that ever hit New York.

ctx.x: Anyway, they used to sing in between dance sets and everything. They used to entertain, you see. And, of course, Benny before that, Benny used to accompany Mattie Hite, who was one of the greatest entertainers that ever hit New York. A cabaret singer and Benny was her accompanist. They used to make -- In those days they made $200 a night tips.
